Issue #11 is a standalone, bounded regression. Source inspection at 4cabe417c868b343fa458a6e42b1da7a4813ec52 confirms that StatelessSessionImpl.internalLoad accepts nullable but does not use it, and its protected internalLoadGet delegates to public get. AbstractSharedSessionContract.get(String, ...) now throws EntityNotFoundException when find returns null. Consequently, missing optional rows cannot reach the association initializer as null. EntitySelectFetchInitializer explicitly handles null and applies NotFound(EXCEPTION) versus NotFound(IGNORE), and SessionImpl enforces mandatory internal loads separately with UnresolvableObjectException.throwIfNull.

Verdict: easy-call. This is a two-way internal loading correction, restricted to hibernate-core stateless loading and focused tests, without changing public get semantics, schema, or method signatures. Preserve the existing three-argument internalLoadGet hook for Hibernate Reactive. Use nullable find inside that hook and enforce mandatory missing rows after its result in internalLoad, following the regular Session contract. Confirm behavior through focused tests rather than relying on the reporter's diagnosis alone.

Markus Westergren supplied the reproduction and get/find diagnosis in HHH-21015; that prior work must be credited. First adapt the reported regular Session missing-detail control, stateless existing-detail control, and stateless missing optional primary-key one-to-one case into a focused regression. Observe RED on unchanged main, then verify GREEN with the smallest correction. Add mandatory missing-row, NotFound(EXCEPTION)/NotFound(IGNORE), public get/find, and existing-target controls. Check the protected extension point remains callable and unchanged. Run JDK 25/H2 focused stateless/association neighbors and repository format checks. No full build or non-H2 claim is made.

CONTRIBUTING.md and classification-tooling.adoc were read. CONTEXT.md and target .sandcastle/CODING_STANDARDS.md are absent; the Sandcastle controller standards were read separately. No code changes or tests were performed during this read-only exploration. No duplicates in this one-issue batch. Remaining validation is runtime RED/GREEN evidence, exact exception behavior for mandatory loading, and confirmation of the Reactive override interaction.
